about_the_game:
Note: When you purchase this DLC, the PC Engine version of “Avenger” will be added to the launcher and become playable. The Telenet Shooting Collection Launcher is required to play.

Avenger (PC Engine version release date: December 7, 1990)

Reclaim the ultimate weapon, VOLOS, from the Allied forces!

Pilot the cutting-edge combat helicopter AVENGER and fight using three weapon categories, primary, support, and special.

Authentic attack-helicopter handling such as nose-lock fixed-direction firing, branching scenarios via mission selection, and intense enemy assaults deliver a high level of challenge in this strategic near-future shooter!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730, 2 GB or AMD Radeon HD 7570, 1GB or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
